notes: Aggregate public statistics only. No patient-level or identifiable data.

Expected deaths use indirect age standardisation: national age-specific cancer death counts (2021-2025, Statistics Finland 11az) applied to each wellbeing services county's 2024 age structure (Statistics Finland 14wx, aggregated from municipalities).
Åland (HVA91) and Helsinki (HVA90) are reported as their own units, as in the source statistics.
